prompts.label: Sukhoi Su-57
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent RTS game aircraft sprite: contemporary Russian Sukhoi Su-57 fighter. Reference image is ONLY painted material/rendering quality, exact overhead camera and compact clean game sprite style; do not copy WWII airframe. EXACT 90-degree vertical overhead orthographic plan view, nose points straight SCREEN UP. Recognizable Su-57 planform: long slender pointed nose, dark canopy, broad flattened blended twin-engine centerbody, swept trapezoidal wings, widely separated twin rear engine nacelles with TWO round rear nozzles, two small outward canted tail fins seen foreshortened FROM ABOVE, separate swept rear horizontal stabilizers. Plausible physically connected aircraft, left/right symmetric geometry. Modern subdued blue-gray/light-gray angular camouflage, subtle panel seams, small red star wing insignia. Compact high clarity silhouette and restrained crisp painted dimensional detail matching reference. No weapons hanging outside, no propellers, no exhaust flames or contrails. One single whole aircraft centered in square transparent canvas, full nose, wings and tails safely inside with at least 90px empty margin all edges, maximum occupancy 80%. Genuine RGBA transparent background, no scenery, shadows outside object, glow, haze, labels, text or atlas. Strict top down: no front views, no visible side walls, no tilted isometric perspective. Render one static master, not animation.

prompts.label: Tupolev Tu-160

Reference image is ONLY painted material/rendering quality, exact overhead camera and game sprite style; do not copy WWII fighter airframe. EXACT 90-degree vertical overhead orthographic plan view, pointed nose faces straight SCREEN UP. Recognizable Tu-160: long narrow white fuselage, black-gray small cockpit windows near front, broad fixed wing-root gloves, symmetric variable-sweep wings in moderately extended low-sweep cruise position for a BROAD bomber silhouette, two paired engine nacelle groups tucked under inner wings with FOUR rear exhaust nozzles total, swept horizontal tailplanes, one central vertical fin foreshortened from directly above. Four engines not four wing-mounted propeller pods. Physically connected plausible left/right symmetric airframe, no extra wings, no detached engines. Warm off-white/light-silver upper surfaces, restrained gray panel detail, small red stars on outer wings. Clear heavy strategic bomber role distinct from compact angular Su-57 fighter, believable Tu-160 planform, crisp dimensional painted RTS sprite. All complete nose/wingtips/tail safely within square frame with at least 90px transparent margin, maximum occupancy 80%; centered whole single aircraft. Genuine RGBA transparent background; no clouds, terrain, external cast shadow, exhaust flames, contrails, glow, text, labels or atlas. No visible underside, no angled/isometric/front view, exact top down. One static master, not animation.
